claim: A game that makes sound through the ROM needs the original .z80 on a 48K machine as its pace control: NextZXOS's ROM3 BEEP runs 12% faster than Sinclair's, so the plain .nex is not a faithful baseline.

evidence.text: Pace control is the original .z80 on a 48K machine, not the plain .nex: NextZXOS's ROM3 BEEP (ROM 0x03F8) runs 12% faster than Sinclair's, so the plain .nex is faster than the original in sound scenes.
evidence.quote: runs 12% faster than Sinclair's, so the plain .nex is faster than the original in sound scenes.
